instance.optimizeHelp.settings.title: In-game settings (vanilla)
instance.optimizeHelp.settings.body: Render distance is the biggest lever: 8 chunks or fewer. Then, by decreasing effect: simulation distance 6–8, graphics “Fast”, smooth lighting and VSync off, Biome Blend 1, entity distance 75%, cap the frame rate and play fullscreen.
instance.optimizeHelp.ram.title: Memory
instance.optimizeHelp.ram.body: More is not better: 4–6 GB is usually enough, and allocating more than half of the system RAM hurts. Change it in instance settings.
instance.optimizeHelp.mods.title: Modded setups
instance.optimizeHelp.mods.body: The biggest FPS gain is the Sodium stack (Sodium + Lithium). The launcher installs it from the catalog in one click: Home → Mods → search “sodium”.
instance.optimizeHelp.system.title: Around the game
instance.optimizeHelp.system.body: Fresh GPU drivers, browser and background apps closed. The launcher installs a suitable Java on its own — no extra setup needed.

crash.diag.java_too_old.title: Java is below the required version
crash.diag.java_too_old.advice: Install the right Java: Settings → Java → Install (1.20.5+ needs Java 21, 1.18–1.20.4 — 17).
crash.diag.gpu_driver.title: GPU driver problem
crash.diag.gpu_driver.advice: Update your graphics driver (NVIDIA/AMD/Intel) to the latest version and restart the game.
crash.diag.out_of_memory.title: Out of memory
crash.diag.out_of_memory.advice: Increase RAM in instance settings (for example, 4096 MB). Don't go above 8 GB — long GC pauses.
crash.diag.duplicate_mod.title: Duplicate mod
crash.diag.duplicate_mod.advice: Two jars for the same mod are in the mods folder. Remove the extra version (see the file name in the error).
crash.diag.missing_fabric_api.title: Missing dependency (usually Fabric API)
crash.diag.missing_fabric_api.advice: Install Fabric API: the Mods page → search fabric-api → Install into the instance.
crash.diag.antivirus_natives.title: Antivirus removed the natives
crash.diag.antivirus_natives.advice: Add the launcher data folder to Windows Defender exclusions (Windows Security → Virus protection → Exclusions) and start the game again — the files will be re-downloaded.
